tasks.spec:
Implement a production-quality, stdlib-only Python 3 utility in the current task directory. Do not inspect or modify anything outside this directory. Do not read live Ringer state, credentials, or provider APIs. Start implementation immediately.

Create verify_ringer_run.py with CLI: --state PATH --eval-log PATH --output PATH. Parse one immutable Ringer state JSON object and append-only eval JSONL rows. Validate that state.finished is true, state.state is finished, summary.fail is zero, tasks is a nonempty list, every task has status pass, verdict PASS, check_returncode 0, check_timed_out false, attempts >= 1, and every declared deliverable path exists when --require-deliverables is supplied. Match eval rows by state.run_id and task key; require at least one matching row per task and require the latest matching row to have verdict PASS and verify_method executed-check. Earlier TIMEOUT or FAIL rows are allowed but must be counted as retries. Emit deterministic JSON with schema_version, run_id, valid, errors, warnings, summary, and per_task entries. Errors and warnings must use stable machine-readable codes plus human-readable messages. Never include spec, notes, check output, URLs, environment values, or file contents in output. Write atomically with parent directory creation. Exit 0 only when valid; otherwise exit 1. Malformed JSON/JSONL, duplicate task keys, missing fields, mismatched run IDs, and inaccessible files must fail cleanly without tracebacks.

Create test_verify_ringer_run.py using unittest and temporary fixture files only. Cover a clean run, retry followed by PASS, unfinished state, nonzero summary failure, failed/timed-out check, missing latest eval PASS, malformed JSONL with line number, duplicate task keys, deliverable requirement success/failure, deterministic ordering, atomic nested output, and redaction of secret-like fixture strings. Invoke the CLI as subprocess and exercise core functions. Include type hints and concise docstrings. Create no files beyond the two expected files and test temporaries.
tasks.check:
set -eu; /Users/hermes/homebrew/bin/python3 -m unittest -v test_verify_ringer_run.py; /Users/hermes/homebrew/bin/python3 -m py_compile verify_ringer_run.py test_verify_ringer_run.py; /Users/hermes/homebrew/bin/python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
for name in ('verify_ringer_run.py','test_verify_ringer_run.py'):
 p=Path(name)
 assert p.is_file(), f'FAIL: expected file is missing: {name}'
 assert p.stat().st_size > 800, f'FAIL: expected substantive implementation: {name}'
text=Path('verify_ringer_run.py').read_text()
for token in ('--state','--eval-log','--output','--require-deliverables','verify_method'):
 assert token in text, f'FAIL: required contract token absent: {token}'
print('PASS: run-evidence verifier compiles and passes executable fixtures for state/eval matching, retries, failures, deliverables, atomic output, and redaction.')
PY
tasks.verified: The verifier compiles and executable fixtures prove deterministic, redacted validation of immutable Ringer state against final eval verdicts and optional deliverables.

Implement a production-quality, stdlib-only Python 3 utility in the current task directory. Do not inspect or modify anything outside this directory. Do not read live Ringer configuration, credentials, or provider APIs. Start implementation immediately.

Create check_ringer_manifest.py with CLI: MANIFEST [--output PATH] [--strict]. Parse a Ringer manifest JSON object without importing Ringer. Validate schema_version equals 3; run_name is a nonempty safe slug; max_parallel is an integer from 1 through 16; worktrees is boolean; default_engine is nonempty; tasks is a nonempty list with unique safe-slug keys. For each task require task_type, engine, a self-contained spec of at least 200 characters, timeout_s integer from 60 through 1800, nonempty check, nonempty expect_files list of safe relative paths, and a verified sentence of at least 40 characters ending in a period. Reject absolute or parent-traversal expect_files, duplicate expected paths, engine/model/provider strings containing the prohibited route name formed by joining the characters t,e,r,r,a case-insensitively, checks that lack both explicit fail-fast behavior and an observable PASS marker, and specs that are only pointers to another file. Emit deterministic JSON with valid, errors, warnings, task_count, and findings. Each finding must include severity, stable code, JSON path, and human message. --strict upgrades warnings to invalid status. Never emit full specs, checks, environment values, or file contents. Write output atomically. Exit 0 only when valid. Malformed JSON and wrong top-level types must fail cleanly without tracebacks.

Create test_check_ringer_manifest.py using unittest and temporary fixtures only. Cover a valid three-task manifest, every top-level contract, duplicate keys, unsafe paths, duplicate expected paths, prohibited route detection in engine/model/provider fields, short/pointer-only specs, weak checks, verified sentence rules, strict warning behavior, deterministic finding order, atomic output, malformed input, and output redaction. Invoke the CLI via subprocess and exercise core functions. Include type hints and concise docstrings. Create no files beyond the two expected files and test temporaries.

tasks.spec:
Implement a production-quality, stdlib-only Python 3 utility in the current task directory. Do not inspect or modify anything outside this directory. Do not read live Ringer state, credentials, or provider APIs. Start implementation immediately.

Create audit_ringer_streak.py with CLI: --states-dir PATH --eval-log PATH --run-prefix PREFIX --required-count N --output PATH. Read only JSON state files in the supplied directory and append-only eval JSONL. Select states whose run_name starts with PREFIX, sort by started_at then run_id, and evaluate the latest contiguous window of N selected finished runs. A run is clean only when finished=true, summary.fail=0, tasks is nonempty, every task has verdict PASS, status pass, check_returncode 0, check_timed_out false, attempts exactly 1, and the latest eval row for every task has verdict PASS with retry false. Reject duplicate run IDs, duplicate task keys, missing/malformed timestamps, missing eval rows, or any selected failed/interrupted run. Earlier runs outside the latest N may be summarized but must not affect acceptance. Emit deterministic redacted JSON with valid, prefix, required_count, selected_count, clean_count, errors, and runs; each run entry includes run_id, started_at, clean, task_count, and stable reason codes only. Never emit specs, checks, notes, logs, paths, URLs, environment values, or file contents. Write atomically with parent creation. Exit 0 only when the latest N runs form a clean streak. Fail cleanly without tracebacks for bad inputs.

Create test_audit_ringer_streak.py using unittest and temporary state/eval fixtures only. Cover an exact clean streak, insufficient runs, failure in the latest window, retries invalidating a run, earlier failure outside the latest window, sort order, duplicate run IDs, duplicate task keys, malformed timestamps, missing eval rows, wrong prefix, deterministic output, atomic nested output, and redaction of secret-like strings. Invoke the CLI via subprocess and exercise core functions. Include type hints and concise docstrings. Create no files beyond the two expected files and test temporaries.
